text:
maria: quick heads-up — PR #4827 (migration guide + SDK snippet) is blocked in review and the docs preview is failing for the versioned site. we need this before the feature-flag cutoff tomorrow.
chen: digging in now. what errors are you seeing in the preview?
maria: preview build shows a 404 for the new migration link; pattern looks like /docs/v2.1/migrate-to-new-opts -> 404. local build is fine.
sam: @maria can you paste the failing URL and the netlify/preview log snippet?
maria: sure — failing URL: https://preview.redwood.ai/docs/v2.1/migrate-to-new-opts
doc-bot: preview build failed — logs: https://ci.redwood.ai/builds/9932/logs (exit code 1) :warning:
eng-ci-bot: Broken link check: 1 broken link found in /content/versioned_docs/version-2.1/migrate.md -> internal path mismatch.
chen: ah — looks like the slug in the frontmatter got renamed to `migrate-to-new-options` while the TOC references `migrate-to-new-opts`. small inconsistency.
kelly: sorry I changed that filename earlier when resolving duplicate slugs. i can push a one-line fix to the PR.
maria: thanks — we also need to coordinate reviewers. PR currently assigned to two reviewers who are both out for PTO. deadline is tomorrow noon PST (release cutoff).
sam: fyi, release cutoffs are strict; if we miss the cutoff we have to queue for next patch. can we get a fallback plan?
tim: fallback: if preview stays red we can merge with ` --no-preview` (internal shortcut) only if @eng-team approves and we add a post-merge hotfix ticket. prefer to avoid.
chen: fix is trivial. @kelly can you push the slug rename and ping reviewers? i'll run the preview again.
kelly: pushing in a sec. patch: frontmatter slug: `migrate-to-new-opts` -> `migrate-to-new-options`. also added a redirect entry to versioned side in case old links exist.
eng-ci-bot: re-run queued preview build #9933 triggered by kelly.
doc-bot: preview build passed on commit 7a3f2b — staging preview: https://preview.redwood.ai/builds/9933 :tada:
maria: amazing, thanks. can the reviewers still take a quick look? two quick things: SDK snippet needs types updated, and the migration example should include a note about quantization flags.
sam: i'll take the SDK snippet now. ping me when pushed.
chen: i'll look at the migration note. if both LGTM we can merge before cutoff.
kelly: added the types tweak and the quantization note. pushed 7a3f2d.
doc-bot: reviewers requested: sam, chen. reminder: 24h auto-merge window only applies after all approvals.
sam: LGTM for the SDK snippet. small nit: change `ClientOptions` -> `InferenceOptions`.
sam: (edited) made the comment inline.
chen: LGTM on migration note. no further changes.
maria: anyone from infra need to sign off for versioned redirects?
eng-ci-bot: redirect changes are within docs only; infra sign-off not required unless they affect CDN cache rules.
maria: perfect. merging now to hit cutoff.
doc-bot: PR #4827 merged by maria at 2487654905.
maria: thanks all — added a follow-up ticket #4870 to monitor e2e docs links across versions. :memo:
kelly: thanks — will watch post-cutover and clear cache if any 404s show up. :eyes:
__notes: This thread models a short docs PR coordination discussion: broken preview due to slug mismatch, reviewer availability, a quick fix and re-run of the preview, and merge before release cutoff. Messages are short and Slack-like, include bots and links. All fields are strings or list of strings per agents.md requirements.
